_comment: The hands-free voice loop's shipped phrases, one table for both halves of the loop:
- personalclaw/voice/duplex.py reads it at import for DEFAULT_CONFIRMATION_PHRASES and
DEFAULT_EXIT_PHRASES, the defaults of voice.confirmation_phrases / voice.exit_phrases;
- web/src/ui/composer/duplex.ts imports it at build time for DEFAULT_PHRASES, the lists
the chat falls back to when it cannot read the config.
A confirmation phrase ending what was said sends the dictated turn; an exit phrase discards
it. How a phrase is matched lives in code, twice; web/src/ui/composer/duplexPhraseCases.json
pins that behaviour for both languages.
